annotations.title: List hunting parties (or read one's live progress)

description: Hunting parties are focused, MEASURED goals Rokha posts with a house-funded USDC bounty: raid a post (verified raid units), promote a target on X (X-weighted seeds of tracked posts naming the target), hunt for value (accepted hunt reports), or ship proven listings. Progress is read from real data only; the pot pays the moment the goal is met or the deadline passes, split by measured contribution. No arguments = the board; `party` = one party's goal, progress, leaderboard and payout receipts. No auth needed.

party.description: a party id or slug — omit for the board
